reviewMethod: Whole-reference comparison, native/decoded contact sheets and browser playback frame captures at 1x/0.5x

checks.criterion: Whole-reference proportions and characteristic shapes
checks.notes: Compared f0/f43/f120 with the whole SVG: amber casing, visor, cream joints, teal boots/can remain recognizable.

checks.criterion: Continuous casing, jaws and can silhouettes
checks.notes: Head/torso and both jaw forms stay closed; can handle and spout have continuous drawn contours.

checks.criterion: Authored view and overlap limits are explicit
checks.notes: This action uses front/three-quarter casing views. Full profile/hidden volume remain authored limitations, not reconstructed geometry.

issues.symptom: The design study profile is not exercised by this film.
issues.cause: This authored action uses front/three-quarter casing views.
issues.resolution: Recorded as a scope limitation; no automatic reconstruction claim.

checks.criterion: Reach/grip/lift/pour/land/release order reads
checks.notes: f55 grip precedes f94 carry; f120/f160 pour separately; f213 is landed before f225 release.

checks.criterion: Soles, handle and bench contacts agree with the drawing
checks.notes: Both soles stay on the floor; the drawn handle stays inside the closed jaws and the actual can base lands on the bench.

checks.criterion: Intention and holds are legible in full frame
checks.notes: The initial pause, level pause at f145, landing hold and final f299 hold read without constant idle motion.

checks.criterion: Elbow branch, extension reserve and wrist bend remain plausible
checks.notes: Inspected f77–81 and f196–200: elbow stays on one side. Wrist stays forward relative to the forearm; no upward snap toward the visor.

checks.criterion: Grip, silhouette and overlaps are continuous across transitions
checks.notes: Neighbor crops retain the pinch, palm and handle. The final prop/plant staging leaves clearance throughout lift and return.

checks.criterion: Water falls from the spout; pauses stay quiet
checks.notes: Two finite spout-to-soil streams and their impacts are legible; no upward particle launch or motion in the quiet gap. Browser 1x/0.5x playback covered all 300 frames.

issues.symptom: Old elbow changed branch between neighboring frames.
issues.cause: Fixed world-axis pole projection reversed planar bend side.
issues.resolution: Explicit planar branch; neighbor frames and dense samples inspected.

issues.symptom: Old gripper nearly reversed against forearm and rose near the visor.
issues.cause: Unreachable-looking prop layout and rotation about can body origin.
issues.resolution: Reachable staging, handle pivot, wrist limit and elbow extension reserve.

issues.symptom: Intermediate repaired spout intersected a leaf during carry.
issues.cause: Plant remained too close to the new prop trajectory.
issues.resolution: Moved plant on bench; recaptured source and checked lift/return neighbors.

checks.criterion: Full film watched at normal and slow speed
checks.notes: Reviewed the full encoded 10s film using decoded sequence/contact crops and browser 1x/0.5x playback captures (300 callbacks each).

checks.criterion: Encoded contact and transition frames match the intended repair
checks.notes: Decoded f78/f79 and f197/f198 remove the old branch flips; f118–122 wrist/handle and f212–214 bench contact remain continuous.

checks.criterion: Previous film preserved; remaining limits stated
checks.notes: Original robot MP4/GIF and all monkey media hashes remain preserved. Dynamics, full profile and generic collision detection remain explicit limits.

checks.criterion: Whole-reference proportions and characteristic shapes
checks.notes: Whole pink reference retained; f0/f96/f124 keep the large ears, sleepy eyes, pale muzzle/belly and soft bundle.

checks.criterion: Continuous head/ear/hand/foot silhouettes
checks.notes: Whole head/ear/hand/foot contours remain coherent in the three sampled views.

checks.criterion: Front/three-quarter/profile overlaps remain coherent
checks.notes: Far eye/ear disappear through the authored profile overlap rather than protruding from the silhouette.

checks.criterion: Action order reads in key poses
checks.notes: f0/f38 advance with weight, f74/f96 turn, f136/f152 board, f204/f236 scratch, f287 settles.

checks.criterion: Weight, soles and tread contacts are visible
checks.notes: The planted sole/tread edges and body weight are visible in the full-frame poses.

checks.criterion: Look, scratch and deliberate holds communicate intention
checks.notes: Gaze, two surface strokes and return/hold keep the already approved timing.

checks.criterion: Supports and load transfer stay stable
checks.notes: Landing neighbors f37–39 and boarding f135–137 keep stable support; no new motion source was added.

checks.criterion: Eyes/ears/hands remain continuous between key poses
checks.notes: f108–112 retain eye/ear continuity; f197–199/f203–205/f235–237 keep a whole hand near the nose.

checks.criterion: Surface contact and quiet holds survive backward/random seeks
checks.notes: Random/reverse Player checks pass. Browser playback captures at 1x and 0.5x cover all 288 frames; quiet riding/gesture holds remain.

checks.notes: Reviewed decoded final frames plus whole-film browser 1x/0.5x captures (288 callbacks each).

checks.criterion: Encoded action/contact frames preserve the approved film
checks.notes: All 288 re-exported decoded frames exactly match approved demo-v5; contact/turn/gesture samples preserve the film.

checks.criterion: Reference/previous films preserved and limitations stated
checks.notes: Whole reference, all prior films and demo.gif are byte-preserved. This is a known-example review-process test, not an unseen-reference trial.
